Regenerated by the scheduled **Data refresh** workflow.

Typecheck, tests and a full Workers build all passed against this data before
the pull request was opened. CI will not re-run them here: a pull request
opened with `GITHUB_TOKEN` does not trigger other workflows.

Worth a look before merging, since these files decide what the site claims is
normal:

- **`src/data/flow-percentiles.json`** — river percentile thresholds. Within a
  month, values should rise across each row; a `0` sitting between larger
  numbers means a threshold went missing upstream.
- **`public/history/*.json`** — period-of-record series. Expect appended
  values, not wholesale rewrites. A file that shrank is a truncated download,
  not a shorter record.
- **`src/lib/slugs.ts`** — new entries mean TWDB added reservoirs.
- **`src/data/flow-gages.json`, `src/data/usace-gages.json`** — changed
  attribution means a gage was retired or re-routed.

Close this pull request to discard the refresh. The branch is reused and
force-pushed on the next run either way.
